valuation.title: Inventory valuation
valuation.provisional: Provisional moving-average value. This is not a posted financial balance.
valuation.unpriced: {{quantity}} units have no reliable cost. Value and average cost are unavailable.

query.title: Stock query
query.invalidDates: End date must not be earlier than start date.

opening.title: Opening stock
opening.invalidDates: The end date cannot be earlier than the start date.
opening.hint: Enter quantities in the item's base unit. Submitting posts the stock immediately and cannot be changed; correct mistakes with other receipts or issues.
opening.invalid: Enter an opening date and at least one valid line. Quantity must be above 0; quantity and unit cost allow up to six decimals.
opening.previewOk: Preview passed: total quantity {{quantity}}, amount {{amount}}. You can submit.
opening.previewErrors: {{count}} error(s) found. Fix them and preview again.
opening.replayed: This batch was already submitted; it was not posted twice.

tracking.duplicate: Lot or serial numbers must be unique.
tracking.dateOrder: Expiry date cannot precede manufacture date.

trace.title: Lot and serial trace
trace.truncated: History exceeds 1,000 records; only the latest 1,000 are shown.

receipt.title: Other receipts
receipt.invalid: Enter a date and at least one valid line. Quantity and unit cost allow up to six decimal places.

issue.title: Other issues
issue.invalid: Enter a date and at least one valid line. Quantity and estimated unit cost allow up to six decimal places.

stocktake.title: Stocktakes
stocktake.scopeHint: Select one or more warehouses. Categories and items are optional filters; selected categories include their children.
stocktake.recount: Book quantity changed. Recount this line before submitting.
stocktake.staleKeys: Stock moved after this snapshot. Review these keys and refresh the snapshot.
stocktake.invalidScope: Select a business date and at least one warehouse.
stocktake.invalidCount: Check each found line and enter nonnegative quantities with up to six decimal places.
stocktake.missing: Every line and lot or serial number must be counted before submission.
stocktake.invalidDates: The end date cannot be earlier than the start date.

transfer.title: Inventory transfers
transfer.invalid: Enter a date and at least one valid line: item and both warehouses are required; quantity must be above 0 with up to six decimal places.
transfer.sameKey: The source and destination warehouse and location must not be identical.
transfer.invalidDates: The end date must not be earlier than the start date.
transfer.hint: Enter quantities in the item's base unit. Lot and serial numbers are taken from the source and moved unchanged; drafts may omit them, but they are required before submitting.
